COMMAND.card: Command is held. The doors and lifts answer to us again.

HABITATS.card: The habitats are held. Crew who can stand are reporting to the suits.

REACTOR.card: Brownout across the ship. Expect dark sections, and the jump rig has less power to work with.

FABRICATION.card: The printers and stores in the keel pod, next to the hangar. Quartermaster's crew report no contact.
